# antislop-ui

> Anti Slop: Rules for AI Coding Agents. UI & Visual skill

> Part of the antislop system. Read together with `antislop.md` (the core). This skill deep-dives the UI/visual concern: color, layout, components, decoration, structural flow, and motion. It references core rules by number and never duplicates or renumbers them. Load it when the task builds or edits a website, web app, or any interface.

## How to use this skill

- Load together with `antislop.md` whenever the task is UI or visual work. The core holds the mechanism (the purpose test, the three tiers, the Delivery Gate); this skill holds UI-specific depth.
- Every entry has the same shape: **Tell** (the pattern), **Why** (why it reads as slop), **Fix** (what to do instead), with the governing core rule cited as R-XX.
- The Delivery Gate in the core remains the gate. The "UI Skill Checklist" at the end of this file is the UI-specific supplement to run alongside it.

## Visual & Color

### Generic Blue-Purple Gradient

- **Tell:** blue-to-purple, blue-to-cyan, or purple-to-pink gradients used as the primary color treatment, or a full-page colored glow.
- **Why:** the most over-represented color treatment in training data. It signals "no brand identity", not "our palette", and marks the design as AI-generated at a glance.
- **Fix:** pull the palette from `DESIGN.md` or the product's own identity. Keep a gradient only as a hierarchy function with the reason written down (R-01). A gradient separating one level from another is craft; the same gradient on every section is a default.
- **The same default family:** harsh or rainbow gradients, purple-and-black schemes, neon or pastel palettes, and blurred radial orbs behind the hero. They are the same tell wearing different clothes: color from the model's default, not from the brand. All of them are FORBIDDEN as defaults without purpose (R-01).

### Excessive Glassmorphism

- **Tell:** blur/backdrop-filter on the navbar, cards, modals, and sidebar at the same time.
- **Why:** blur removes texture and sits every surface in the same frosted layer, flattening hierarchy. When every surface is glass, nothing is foreground.
- **Fix:** treat glass as an accent, not a character trait. Dose cap: at most 1-2 elements (R-10). The surface that needs the attention gets the glass; everything else stays solid.

### Excessive Border Radius

- **Tell:** every element is pill-shaped: buttons, inputs, cards, badges, modals.
- **Why:** uniform pill shapes erase the visual language of "this is an input, this is a card". Radius becomes decoration instead of a hierarchy tool.
- **Fix:** set a small set of radii in the design system and apply them deliberately (R-11). One generous radius on the primary CTA reads as intentional; the same radius on every element reads as a default.

### Overly Soft Shadows

- **Tell:** every component carries a large shadow, so the whole page feels like it is floating.
- **Why:** when everything is elevated, elevation communicates nothing. The page loses its ground plane and becomes generic softness.
- **Fix:** use shadow as an elevation marker only, and write the elevation reason down (R-12). Most elements should sit flat; the one or two that need to lift above the page carry the shadow.

### Glow Everywhere

- **Tell:** glow on cards, buttons, icons, badges, backgrounds, and borders simultaneously.
- **Why:** glow is an attention amplifier. Applied everywhere it amplifies nothing, and it is one of the fastest ways to look "made by AI".
- **Fix:** reserve glow for a maximum of 1-2 important elements as a focus accent (R-13). Everything else stays matte.

### Background Grid

- **Tell:** grid squares, blueprint lines, graph paper, dot grids, or thin repeating lines behind content.
- **Why:** it is a default way to make a flat page feel "technical" without doing any real work. It reads as texture without intent.
- **Fix:** use texture or pattern only when it genuinely supports the product's identity, with the reason written down (R-07). A real identity motif (core Part 3) beats a stock grid every time.

### Dark Mode Default for No Reason

- **Tell:** the whole page is dark simply because it looks "tech", with no branding consideration.
- **Why:** dark is a decision, not a default. Forcing it reads as following a trend, not serving the product.
- **Fix:** choose the theme from brand identity, product type, and audience (R-21). Developer and creative tools have legitimate reasons for dark; a content-first product usually does not. If there is no strong reason for a fixed theme, build a working light/dark toggle.

### Too Many Colors in the Palette

- **Tell:** 5-7 different colors on one page with no clear design system.
- **Why:** a scattered palette has no hierarchy. When every element can be any color, nothing is distinguished.
- **Fix:** cap the active palette at 2-3 core colors + 1 accent (R-29), and let one of the cores be the neutral base. Restraint is what makes the accent land.

### Excessive Accent Color

- **Tell:** one accent color on buttons, icons, badges, links, lines, backgrounds, and glows at once.
- **Why:** the accent stops being an accent the moment it is everywhere. It becomes just another color, and the design loses its focal point.
- **Fix:** the accent belongs at the key moment only (one deliberate accent, core Part 3). Zero accents is sterile; an accent everywhere is slop. Choose the one or two places it matters.

### Sterile Default

- **Tell:** flat white or near-white, thin grey borders, small radius, no texture, generic font, no identity.
- **Why:** this is the "safe" result of over-filtering without direction. It is not slop, but it is not design either: it is a void where a design should be.
- **Fix:** this is a direction problem, not a filter problem. Add `DESIGN.md` or resolve the Design Read (core Part 3), then raise the liveliness dials. The fix is never more bans; it is state the purpose and add energy.

## Layout & Components

### Monotonous Template Layout

- **Tell:** hero, subtitle, 2 CTAs, screenshot, feature grid, testimonials, FAQ, CTA, footer, in that order, every time.
- **Why:** the order is the training-data default, not the product's narrative. Sections appear because the template has them, not because the content needs them.
- **Fix:** build the structure around actual content needs (R-05, C-3). If the product has no testimonials, there is no testimonials section. Section order follows the product's story. Match the RHYTHM dial: if it is 3, sections visibly vary.

### Copy-Paste Feature Cards

- **Tell:** identical size, height, icon, layout, and padding across all feature cards.
- **Why:** uniform cards flatten the content. When every feature is a card with an icon, the features with real weight and the ones without look the same.
- **Fix:** create variation that reflects content hierarchy, with the reason written down (R-14). Not every feature needs to be a card. The flagship feature may deserve a full-width treatment, the supporting ones a list.

### Bento Grid

- **Tell:** a section made of a mosaic of differently-sized cards, some spanning two columns or two rows, filling the space like a tiled dashboard.
- **Why:** it is the default "app-like" landing layout of the last few years, so it signals nothing about the product. When every section could be a bento, the layout is a template, not a decision.
- **Fix:** use a bento grid only when the content genuinely has elements of different sizes to show (R-05). If every cell is roughly the same, a simple grid or list is more honest. The RHYTHM dial decides whether sections vary at all.

### Uniform Spacing

- **Tell:** padding, margin, and gaps are identical across every section.
- **Why:** rhythm is a tool, and a single spacing value removes it. Sections stop relating to each other; the page reads as one flat strip.
- **Fix:** use whitespace as structure (core Part 3) and vary it with the RHYTHM dial. Establish a spacing scale, then use different levels to separate and connect. Uniform rhythm is a deliberate choice only when the dial says so (R-05).

### "How It Works" Always 3 Steps

- **Tell:** round icon + number 1, 2, 3 + short text, always three steps, always the same shape.
- **Why:** the product's real process is rarely a tidy three-step list. The template forces the process into its shape, not the other way around.
- **Fix:** present the process as it actually is (R-05). Three steps with round icons is fine if that is genuinely the process; otherwise use whatever shape the real workflow takes, including two steps or five.

### "Trusted By" Logo Bar

- **Tell:** a row of generic company logos directly below the hero.
- **Why:** it is a trust claim with no evidence: generic logos, no real customers named, no proof of use.
- **Fix:** only show real, verifiable logos (R-18, R-36, C-5). If the product has no such customers yet, do not fabricate a logo bar. Real social proof beats a generic one every time.

### "Most Popular" Pricing Card

- **Tell:** the middle pricing tier always highlighted with a capsule badge.
- **Why:** it is the default pattern, which means it is not a decision. When every pricing section does it, the highlighted tier stops meaning anything.
- **Fix:** highlight the tier that actually serves the product's goals, and write why (R-31). If no tier deserves emphasis, highlight none.
- **Three columns is part of the tell:** pricing shown as three tiers whatever the real structure, the middle one highlighted. That shape is the default, so it is not a decision (R-05). Use as many tiers as the product really has, and highlight the one that serves it.

### Demo Without a Product

- **Tell:** the page sells a product that is never shown working: no real demo, no Terms of Service, no Privacy Policy, just promises.
- **Why:** it is a demo wearing a product's clothes. Every claim is trust with nothing behind it, and the missing legal pages are the quiet tell that nothing real exists yet.
- **Fix:** show the real product working, or say honestly that it is not shipped yet (R-38, C-5). If the page asks for signups or payment, the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy must exist. An honest "coming soon" beats a convincing demo.

### 4-Column Template Footer

- **Tell:** Product / Company / Resources / Legal columns with no variation.
- **Why:** the columns exist because templates have them, not because the site has that many link groups.
- **Fix:** structure the footer around what the product actually links to (R-05). A single column of links can be more useful than four half-empty ones.

### Uniform Section Rhythm

- **Tell:** every section is centered title + subtitle + identical card grid, with no variation.
- **Why:** identical composition makes sections blur together, and the page feels repetitive and flat.
- **Fix:** vary composition with the RHYTHM dial (R-05). Alternate text-heavy and visual sections, asymmetric and symmetric layouts. A page where every section follows the same template is a page designed by a template.

## Decorative Elements

### Generic AI Icons

- **Tell:** sparkle, star, magic, lightning, diamond, cube, robot, or AI orb as feature icons.
- **Why:** these glyphs are the generic vocabulary of "AI product". They communicate nothing about the specific feature.
- **Fix:** use icons genuinely relevant to the content, with the relevance written down when the glyph is generic (R-04). If no appropriate icon exists, use none. The feature label does the work.

### Lucide Icons

- **Tell:** every icon comes from the same thin-stroke, rounded-corner library (Lucide or a visual clone), so all icons share one recognizable look.
- **Why:** a single default icon library makes every AI site's icons identical, so the icons stop telling you anything about the product. The glyphs may be relevant; the uniform library look is the tell.
- **Fix:** the icon set is a visual choice, not a default (R-04). Pick icons for relevance first; then decide whether the library's weight and stroke suit the product's character. Two icons that look "same-ish" can still read as yours if the set is a decision, not an import.

### Emoji as Decoration

- **Tell:** literal emoji scattered through the copy, headings, badges, and buttons: 🚀 in a headline, ✅ beside every feature bullet, 🔥 on a CTA, 📈 above a chart title.
- **Why:** emoji is the loudest shorthand for "this was generated, not written". In a UI it competes with the content for attention and flattens the product's voice into the same cheerful default as every other AI site.
- **Fix:** remove emoji from UI text. If a concept needs a mark, use a real, relevant icon with the reason written down (R-04), or no mark at all. The copy carries the meaning; the emoji adds nothing.

### Small Arrows on Every Button

- **Tell:** `→` or `↗` placed on almost every button as pure decoration.
- **Why:** the arrow becomes a pattern, not a signal. When every CTA has one, none of them point anywhere specific.
- **Fix:** arrows are not the default identity for buttons (R-08). Keep them for the action that genuinely benefits from a direction cue, sized proportionally, with the purpose written down.

### Colored Left Stripe

- **Tell:** a thin colored vertical bar on the left edge of cards, list rows, or section headers, used as decoration.
- **Why:** the stripe adds color without adding meaning. It is the cheapest way to make a card "look designed", so it appears everywhere and says nothing.
- **Fix:** the stripe is decoration; it must carry information or go (R-01, R-31). A left edge that marks real state (active, warning, new) is a signal. A stripe that exists to look designed is a default.

### AI Capsule Badges

- **Tell:** pill shape, thin border, glow, small dot, uppercase, containing "AI Powered", "Beta", "New".
- **Why:** the capsule-plus-glow-plus-dot combination is a self-referential badge that says "made by AI, about being made by AI". It adds noise, not information.
- **Fix:** badges only when functionally needed, with the need written down, and never the full combination (R-09). A real status label is fine; a decorative "AI Powered" pill is not.

### Eyebrow Badge Above the Headline

- **Tell:** a small pill sitting directly above the H1, often with a dot and a thin border, holding a category label ("Aplikasi Tagihan UKM", "The platform for teams") that the headline beneath it already says.
- **Why:** the badge duplicates the headline, so it adds a line of reading without adding a fact. It lands in the same spot on every generated page, which is why it reads as a template rather than a decision. When it carries a dot as well, it borrows status-indicator language for a label that marks no state.
- **Fix:** cut it and let the headline do the work. If the label carries information the headline does not, fold it into the headline or the subheadline, where it reads as content instead of ornament. A badge above the fold needs a written reason like any other badge (R-09), and a dot inside it needs a real state to mark (R-31).

### Decorative Status Dot

- **Tell:** a small colored dot beside a heading, eyebrow, nav item, or label, usually glowing and pulsing on a loop, that marks nothing. It borrows the visual language of a live or recording indicator for a page where nothing is live.
- **Why:** the dot is an attention grab with nothing behind it: a glow plus an endless pulse is a double bid for the eye over a fact that does not exist. It reads as AI because generated pages reach for system-status vocabulary as decoration, and the same dot lands in the same place on every one of them.
- **Fix:** a dot must mark a real state (active, live, recording, warning). If it does, keep one dot, drop the glow, and drop the endless pulse (R-19). If it marks nothing, remove it: a heading needs no indicator to be a heading (R-31).

### Generic AI Typography

- **Tell:** large monospace headings, or uppercase labels with extreme letter-spacing ("HOW IT WORKS", "FEATURES").
- **Why:** monospace-as-aesthetic and wide-tracked uppercase are shorthand for "technical and modern" without doing any real typographic work.
- **Fix:** choose typeface from brand character, not the model's default pick, and write the reason (R-06). Typography must improve readability and reflect the product. A type choice with a reason beats a trend every time.
- **The default roster:** Inter, Geist, and Space Grotesk for sans; Geist Mono, JetBrains Mono, and Fira Code for mono. None are banned; each is valid with a brand reason. The tell is the font that shows up because it was the default, not because it fits (R-06).

### Fake Terminal Window

- **Tell:** a styled terminal window with traffic-light dots, a prompt line, and typed-out commands, used as the hero or feature visual.
- **Why:** it is the generic "this is a developer tool" costume. The window is decoration; the real product rarely looks like that. It reads as a placeholder for a real screenshot.
- **Fix:** if the product is genuinely a terminal or CLI, a real, working screenshot is evidence. Otherwise show the actual product UI, not a costume (R-06, C-5). Monospace as aesthetic is already covered by R-06; a fake terminal is that pattern as a component.

### Illustrations With No Connection

- **Tell:** Undraw, Storyset, or generic 3D blob characters with no real connection to the product.
- **Why:** decorative illustrations say the design is decorated, not designed. They fill space without serving the content.
- **Fix:** illustrations must have a direct connection to the product, with the connection written down (R-22). If none exists, use real screenshots or no illustration.

## Structural & Flow

### Dead Navigation

- **Tell:** navbar links to pages or sections that do not exist.
- **Why:** dead links are a broken promise. They break trust the moment a user clicks them.
- **Fix:** every navigation item must have a real destination (R-24). If a feature is not built, leave it out, or label it "Coming soon" clearly. The navbar reflects content that actually exists.

### Non-Functional Controls

- **Tell:** buttons do nothing, dropdowns won't open, forms cannot submit.
- **Why:** the visual is finished but the behavior is not. This is the difference between a mockup and a product.
- **Fix:** every interactive element has real behavior, or it is removed (R-26). If an element genuinely cannot have a destination, ship a clear `// TODO` plus a visible "Coming soon" label, or do not ship it.

### Sections That Fill a Template

- **Tell:** a section exists because "every AI landing page has one", not because the content needs it.
- **Why:** template sections are content without purpose. They add length and remove focus.
- **Fix:** every section earns its place from the product's content (C-3). Remove sections that only fill a template. A page with fewer, purposeful sections is stronger than a page with all the defaults.

## App & Dashboard

The patterns above are landing-page shapes. These are the app-side equivalents: the defaults an agent reaches for when the screen is a dashboard, an admin panel, or any signed-in view. The rules they break are the same ones; only the shape is new.

### Default Dashboard Shell

- **Tell:** left sidebar, top bar, four stat cards, a chart, a table. Chosen before anyone asked what the screen is for, and identical whether it manages invoices, patients, or servers.
- **Why:** it is the landing-page template problem in an app: a layout picked from memory instead of from the work the screen supports. Swap the labels and it belongs to any product.
- **Fix:** name the screen's job and the one decision the user makes on it, then build the hierarchy around that (C-3, R-20). If the job is "spot the failing job and retry it", the failing jobs are the page and the stat row is a footnote. Sections that survive only because dashboards usually have them get cut (C-3).

### Stat Cards With Invented Numbers

- **Tell:** a row of four cards reading 12,483 / 94.2% / $48.2K / 1,204, each with a green "+12% this week" delta.
- **Why:** the numbers are decoration, and the deltas are worse: a trend claim with no series behind it. Real dashboards have metrics that matter and metrics that do not, so four equal cards is already a hierarchy failure.
- **Fix:** show real numbers or none (R-17, R-38). Wire the cards to real data, or ship the one metric that is real. A delta appears only when the comparison period is real and named. If the screen is a prototype, label the values as placeholder where the user can see it (R-38).

### Filler Activity Feed

- **Tell:** "Sarah Chen updated a document, 2 hours ago", repeated with rotating names and avatars.
- **Why:** invented people, invented events. It is the testimonial section wearing a different layout, and it makes an empty product look busy.
- **Fix:** the feed shows real events or does not ship (R-18, R-38). An honest empty state beats a fabricated feed, and it tells the user what to do first (R-27).

### Charts Without a Question

- **Tell:** a line or donut chart placed because the space looked bare, with a generic title ("Overview", "Performance") and no axis the reader can act on.
- **Why:** a chart is an answer. Without the question, it is texture, and it costs more attention than a sentence would.
- **Fix:** write the question the chart answers before drawing it, and put that question in the title ("Failed jobs per hour, last 24h"). If a sentence answers it better, write the sentence (C-3). Chart segments still need 3:1 contrast against their neighbours (R-25).

### Generic Table Columns

- **Tell:** Name, Status, Date, Actions, whatever the rows actually are, with a three-dot menu on every row.
- **Why:** the columns come from the table component, not from the data. The user scans for the field that decides their next move and it is not there.
- **Fix:** pick columns from the decision the user makes in this table, and put the deciding field early. The row menu holds actions that exist; anything that does nothing comes out (R-26).

### Filler Data in Fields and Columns

- **Tell:** empty form fields and table columns filled with fake but plausible data: `John Doe`, `johndoe@example.com`, `"Let's build something"`, phone numbers and dates that belong to nobody.
- **Why:** fabricated content disguised as real. It reads fine in a mockup and falls apart the moment a real user looks: the name is not a customer, the email is not a lead, and the message is a tagline. It is the strongest tell that the screen was generated, not built.
- **Fix:** leave empty cells empty, or use placeholders that clearly say what goes there: `Your Name`, `email@example.com`, `Drop your message here...`, or `[REAL DATA]` when a value is expected (R-23, R-38). Real data goes in when it exists. Generic filler copy like "Let's build something" is buzzword slop and does not belong in a data column (R-16).

### Placeholder Empty and Loading States

- **Tell:** "No data available" with an illustration, a bare spinner, or a full-page skeleton that mimics a layout the real data never fills.
- **Why:** R-27 requires the states, and these technically have them. They still tell the user nothing: no cause, no next action, no idea whether this is normal.
- **Fix:** an empty state says why it is empty and gives the one action that fills it ("No jobs yet. Run a sync to see results here"). A loading state says what it is loading. An error state says what failed and what to do next (R-27). First run, filtered to nothing, and permission denied are different screens and read differently.

## Motion

### Endless Pulses and Loops

- **Tell:** elements that pulse, bounce, or float forever with no user trigger.
- **Why:** perpetual motion is noise. It competes with the content for attention and never stops to let the user rest.
- **Fix:** motion must have a clear UX purpose, written down (R-19). Animation guides attention to a moment; it does not run on a loop. If the MOTION dial is 1 (hover states only), an endless loop is a FAIL against the declared dial.

### Template Animations Stacked

- **Tell:** every element uses Fade Up + Fade In + Floating + Scale + Bounce simultaneously.
- **Why:** a page where everything animates has no focal point. Motion becomes wallpaper.
- **Fix:** choreograph motion to a purpose and to the MOTION dial (R-19). Not everything moves. The hero speaks, the supporting elements stay calm. Claimed "cinematic" pages must actually move; claimed "static" pages must not.

## Performance

A page that looks finished but shifts under the thumb or shows its main image last was built for the screenshot, not for use. R-40 gates what the code shows; the LCP, INP, and CLS thresholds are field data and live in [references/CORE-WEB-VITALS.md](references/CORE-WEB-VITALS.md), read when a real measurement exists. Never report a number that was not measured (R-36).

### Unsized Media That Shifts the Layout

- **Tell:** `<img>`, `<video>`, `<iframe>`, ads, or embeds with no `width`/`height` or `aspect-ratio`; a banner or late font that pushes content down.
- **Why:** the page jumps while people read or tap, and they hit the wrong control (R-40).
- **Fix:** give every media element intrinsic dimensions or `aspect-ratio`, reserve space for anything that loads late, and overlay banners instead of inserting them above content.

### Hero Image Loaded Like Any Other Image

- **Tell:** the largest above-the-fold image is `loading="lazy"`, set as a CSS background, or injected by JavaScript.
- **Why:** the browser discovers the most important pixel last, and the first impression is an empty box (R-40).
- **Fix:** an `<img>` in the HTML with `fetchpriority="high"`, never lazy; lazy-load only what is below the fold.

### Render-Blocking Third-Party Script

- **Tell:** synchronous analytics, chat, or tag-manager scripts in `<head>`.
- **Why:** nothing paints until someone else's server answers, which on a phone on a slow network is the whole first impression (R-40).
- **Fix:** `defer`/`async`, or load on interaction.

## Page Basics

Optional page-level checks. Not a gate.

### Web Baseline Checklist

- **Tell:** a page shipped with no doctype, mixed `http://` content, a secret in client code, or an unpinned third-party script.
- **Why:** none of it shows in a screenshot, so it is the first thing skipped, and each one is expensive to find after launch.
- **Fix:** run the checklist in [references/WEB-BASELINE.md](references/WEB-BASELINE.md) when the task asks for a production-ready page or a web-quality review.

## UI Skill Checklist

Run these alongside the core Delivery Gate when the task is UI work. All answers must be **yes**:

- [ ] Is the palette derived from `DESIGN.md` or a written brand identity, not the default gradient set? (R-01, R-29)

9: 
10: **Toolsman** adalah website kumpulan alat (tools) gratis yang membantu mahasiswa informatika dan software developer pemula mengerjakan tugas, proyek, dan kebutuhan sehari-hari: menggambar dan menulis di kanvas, membuat flowchart/diagram, mengolah PDF, mengganti background pas foto, mengirim file via link, hingga membuat file `.md` dan `.json`.

169: 
170: ### 7.6 Kirim File via Link
171: 
172: | ID | Kebutuhan | Prioritas |
173: |---|---|---|
174: | FR-SHARE-01 | Unggah satu atau beberapa file (drag-and-drop), maks. **100 MB per berkas** (dapat disesuaikan). | P0 |
175: | FR-SHARE-02 | Hasilkan link unik yang sulit ditebak (ID acak ≥ 128 bit) beserta tombol salin & QR code. | P0 |
176: | FR-SHARE-03 | Pilih masa berlaku: **1 jam / 24 jam / 7 hari**; file dihapus otomatis setelah kedaluwarsa. | P0 |
177: | FR-SHARE-04 | Opsi **batas unduhan** (mis. 1× unduh lalu hangus). | P1 |
178: | FR-SHARE-05 | Opsi **kata sandi** untuk link. | P1 |
179: | FR-SHARE-06 | Halaman unduhan menampilkan nama file, ukuran, dan sisa waktu. | P0 |
180: | FR-SHARE-07 | Progres unggah, pembatalan, dan percobaan ulang otomatis (unggah *multipart*/resumable). | P1 |
181: | FR-SHARE-08 | Tombol **Laporkan penyalahgunaan** pada halaman unduhan. | P0 |
182: 
183: **Arsitektur:** unggah langsung dari browser ke *object storage* melalui *presigned URL* (mis. Cloudflare R2 atau Supabase Storage); metadata & masa berlaku di database kecil; *cron/scheduled job* membersihkan file kedaluwarsa.
184: 
185: **Pengamanan & penyalahgunaan:**
186: - Rate limiting per IP dan Turnstile/hCaptcha ringan.
187: - Blokir tipe file berbahaya (`.exe`, `.bat`, `.scr`, dll.) atau beri peringatan.
188: - Pemindaian malware opsional (v1.1+) dan mekanisme takedown dari laporan.
189: - Syarat penggunaan jelas: dilarang untuk konten ilegal/melanggar hak cipta.
190: - Tidak mencatat isi file; log minimal dan dihapus berkala.
191: 
192: > **Penting:** dari semua fitur, ini yang paling berisiko disalahgunakan dan menimbulkan biaya. Mulai dengan kuota kecil dan pantau.
193: 
194: ### 7.7 Generator (.md, JSON, dan lainnya)
195: 
196: | ID | Kebutuhan | Prioritas |
197: |---|---|---|
198: | FR-GEN-01 | **Markdown editor** split view dengan pratinjau GFM (tabel, task list, code block + syntax highlight). | P0 |
199: | FR-GEN-02 | **README generator:** form (nama proyek, deskripsi, fitur, instalasi, lisensi, badge) → keluaran `.md`. | P0 |
200: | FR-GEN-03 | Unduh `.md` dan salin ke clipboard. | P0 |
201: | FR-GEN-04 | **JSON formatter/validator:** *pretty print*, *minify*, tampilkan error + posisi baris. | P0 |
202: | FR-GEN-05 | **JSON ↔ CSV / YAML** konversi sederhana. | P1 |
203: | FR-GEN-06 | **`.gitignore` generator** (pilih bahasa/framework) dan **LICENSE generator** (MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0, dll.). | P1 |
204: | FR-GEN-07 | Utilitas kecil: Base64, URL encode/decode, JWT decoder, UUID, timestamp converter. | P1 |
205: | FR-GEN-08 | Pembuat QR code (teks/URL, unduh PNG/SVG). | P1 |
206: 
207: ## 8. Kebutuhan Non-Fungsional
208: 
209: | Area | Target |
210: |---|---|
211: | **Performa** | LCP < 2,5 s di 4G; JS awal halaman beranda < 150 KB (gzip); alat berat dimuat *lazy*. |
212: | **Responsif** | Nyaman mulai 360 px (HP) hingga layar lebar; alat tetap fungsional di HP (tata letak menyesuaikan). |
213: | **Aksesibilitas** | Sesuai WCAG 2.1 AA: kontras warna, navigasi keyboard, label ARIA, *focus ring* jelas. |
214: | **Privasi** | Alat client-side tidak mengirim isi file ke server; kebijakan privasi singkat dan mudah dipahami. |
215: | **Keamanan** | HTTPS, CSP ketat, sanitasi pratinjau Markdown (cegah XSS), validasi tipe & ukuran file di server. |
216: | **Ketersediaan** | Target 99,5% (mengandalkan CDN/edge hosting). |
217: | **Kompatibilitas** | Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari (2 versi terakhir), Android Chrome, iOS Safari. |
218: | **Offline** | v2: PWA agar alat client-side bisa dipakai tanpa internet. |
219: | **Analitik** | Privacy-friendly (mis. Plausible/Umami), tanpa cookie pelacak. |
220: | **SEO** | Satu halaman per alat dengan judul, deskripsi, dan *structured data*; target kata kunci Indonesia ("gabung pdf online", "ganti background pas foto"). |
221: 
222: ## 9. Arsitektur & Teknologi (Rekomendasi)
223: 
224: | Lapisan | Pilihan | Alasan |
225: |---|---|---|
226: | Framework | **Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript** | SSR/SSG untuk SEO, ekosistem besar, mudah dipelajari mahasiswa |
227: | Styling | **Tailwind CSS** + komponen bergaya shadcn/ui | Cepat, konsisten, mudah memakai design token |
228: | Draw | `@excalidraw/excalidraw` | Alat siap pakai (MIT) |
229: | Diagram | `mermaid` + embed diagrams.net | Teks→diagram + opsi visual |
230: | PDF | `pdf-lib`, `pdfjs-dist`, Web Worker | Proses lokal |
231: | Hapus background | `@imgly/background-removal` (ONNX/WASM) | Berjalan di browser |
232: | Markdown | `react-markdown` / `marked` + `DOMPurify` + `highlight.js` | Pratinjau aman |
233: | Editor kode | CodeMirror 6 | Ringan dan modular |
234: | Kirim file | Cloudflare R2 (atau Supabase Storage) + Workers/Edge Functions + D1/Postgres | Egress murah, presigned upload |
235: | Hosting | Vercel atau Cloudflare Pages | Tier gratis memadai untuk MVP |
236: | Analitik | Plausible / Umami | Privasi |
237: 
238: **Struktur modul alat (konvensi):**
239: ```
240: /app
241:   /tools/[slug]/page.tsx     ← halaman alat (SEO)
242: /features
243:   /draw  /diagram  /pdf  /photo  /share  /generator
244:     ├─ components/
245:     ├─ lib/ (logika murni, mudah diuji)
246:     └─ meta.ts (nama, slug, ikon, kategori, sinonim pencarian)
247: ```
248: Katalog beranda dibangun otomatis dari `meta.ts` setiap alat, sehingga menambah alat baru tidak mengubah kode beranda.
249: 
250: ## 10. Alur Pengguna Utama
251: 
252: **Ganti background pas foto**
253: 1. Beranda → *Pas Foto* → unggah foto
254: 2. Model memuat (progres) → background terhapus otomatis
255: 3. Pilih warna (merah/biru) & ukuran (3×4)
256: 4. Atur posisi wajah dengan panduan
257: 5. Unduh PNG / lembar cetak
258: 
259: **Kirim file**
260: 1. *Kirim File* → seret berkas
261: 2. Pilih masa berlaku (+ opsi sandi)
262: 3. Unggah → link + QR muncul
263: 4. Salin & bagikan → penerima membuka halaman unduhan
264: 
265: ## 11. Metrik Keberhasilan
266: 
267: | Metrik | Target 3 bulan pertama |
268: |---|---|
269: | Pengguna aktif bulanan | 2.000+ (organik dari kampus & komunitas) |
270: | Tingkat penyelesaian tugas alat (hasil diunduh/disalin) | ≥ 60% |
271: | Alat dipakai per sesi | ≥ 1,5 |
272: | LCP rata-rata | < 2,5 s |
273: | Laporan penyalahgunaan yang tertangani < 24 jam | 100% |
274: | Skor kepuasan (survei 1 pertanyaan) | ≥ 4/5 |
275: 
276: ## 12. Risiko & Mitigasi
277: 
278: | Risiko | Dampak | Mitigasi |
279: |---|---|---|
280: | Penyalahgunaan layanan kirim file | Hukum, biaya | Batas ukuran/kedaluwarsa, rate limit, laporan, ToS, mulai dengan kuota kecil |
281: | Biaya storage/bandwidth membengkak | Operasional | R2 (tanpa biaya egress), batas harian, hapus otomatis |
282: | Model hapus background berat di HP lama | UX buruk | Indikator progres, cache model, opsi resolusi lebih rendah |
283: | Kompres PDF di klien kurang optimal | Ekspektasi tidak terpenuhi | Jujur soal batasan; pertimbangkan *server fallback* opsional di v1.1 |
284: | Lisensi pustaka pihak ketiga | Hukum | Audit lisensi; patuhi atribusi (Excalidraw MIT, Mermaid MIT, draw.io Apache-2.0) |
285: | Menyerupai produk lain (merek dagang) | Hukum | Nama, logo, dan UI orisinal; tidak memakai nama/merek iLovePDF, Excalidraw, draw.io sebagai merek Toolsman |
286: | Scope terlalu luas untuk tim kecil | Jadwal molor | Disiplin MVP; satu alat selesai dulu sebelum lanjut |
287: 
288: ## 13. Rencana Rilis (Sprint 2 Minggu)
289: 
290: | Sprint | Fokus |
291: |---|---|
292: | S1 | Setup proyek, design system, layout, beranda + pencarian, dark mode |
293: | S2 | Generator: Markdown editor, README, JSON formatter |
294: | S3 | PDF: merge, split, image→PDF |
295: | S4 | Draw (Excalidraw) + Diagram (Mermaid) |
296: | S5 | Pas Foto + (opsional) kompres PDF |
297: | S6 | Kirim File + pengamanan, uji beban kecil |
298: | S7 | QA, aksesibilitas, SEO, beta bersama teman kampus |
299: 
300: ## 14. Pertanyaan Terbuka
301: 
302: 1. Apakah batas 100 MB per file untuk Kirim File sudah sesuai dengan anggaran hosting?
303: 2. Apakah perlu akun opsional (login Google/GitHub) sejak v1, atau tunggu v2?
304: 3. Apakah Toolsman akan open-source di GitHub (berpotensi menarik kontributor dari kampus)?
305: 4. Domain yang diinginkan (mis. `toolsman.id`, `toolsman.app`)?
306: 5. Apakah ada kebutuhan kolaborasi real-time pada Draw di tahap awal?
307: 
308: ## 15. Lampiran — Ringkasan Prioritas
309: 
310: - **Harus ada (P0):** Katalog + pencarian, Draw, Mermaid, PDF merge/split/kompres/gambar→PDF, Pas Foto, Kirim File, Markdown/README, JSON formatter
311: - **Segera menyusul (P1):** draw.io embed, PDF→gambar, `.gitignore`/LICENSE, Base64/JWT/Regex/Diff, QR code, password & one-time link
312: - **Nanti (P2):** akun, PWA, kolaborasi, code-to-image, mock data, cron builder

(End of file - total 312 lines)

display.text:
# PRD — Toolsman

> **Versi:** 1.0 (Draft) · **Tanggal:** 4 November 2026 · **Status:** Siap review
> **Tagline:** *Kotak perkakas gratis untuk mahasiswa dan developer.*

---

## 1. Ringkasan

**Toolsman** adalah website kumpulan alat (tools) gratis yang membantu mahasiswa informatika dan software developer pemula mengerjakan tugas, proyek, dan kebutuhan sehari-hari: menggambar dan menulis di kanvas, membuat flowchart/diagram, mengolah PDF, mengganti background pas foto, mengirim file via link, hingga membuat file `.md` dan `.json`.

Prinsip utama: **cepat, gratis, tanpa login, dan privat** (sebisa mungkin file diproses langsung di browser pengguna).

## 2. Latar Belakang & Masalah

Mahasiswa dan developer pemula biasanya harus membuka banyak situs berbeda untuk kebutuhan sederhana. Masalah yang sering muncul:

| Masalah | Dampak |
|---|---|
| Alat tersebar di banyak situs (Excalidraw, draw.io, iLovePDF, remove.bg, WeTransfer, dll.) | Boros waktu, harus pindah-pindah tab |
| Banyak situs gratis penuh iklan, batas harian, atau memaksa daftar | Mengganggu alur kerja |
| File diunggah ke server pihak ketiga | Risiko privasi untuk dokumen tugas, KTP, ijazah, foto |
| Pas foto untuk administrasi kampus/lamaran membutuhkan editor berat atau berbayar | Mahasiswa sering bayar jasa foto/edit hanya untuk ganti background |
| Developer pemula sering butuh utilitas kecil (format JSON, README, dll.) | Mencari satu per satu, kualitas situs tidak konsisten |

## 3. Tujuan & Non-Tujuan

### 3.1 Tujuan
1. Menjadi **satu pintu** untuk alat harian mahasiswa dev, dengan pengalaman yang konsisten.
2. Semua alat inti **gratis dan dapat dipakai tanpa akun**.
3. Mayoritas pemrosesan berjalan **di sisi klien** agar file pengguna tidak meninggalkan perangkat.
4. Halaman cepat dimuat, nyaman di HP maupun laptop, dan mendukung bahasa Indonesia.
5. Mudah dikembangkan: menambah alat baru cukup mengikuti pola modul yang sama.

### 3.2 Non-Tujuan (di luar cakupan v1)
- Platform kolaborasi real-time berskala besar
- Penyimpanan cloud permanen / drive pribadi
- Editor kode / IDE online penuh
- Monetisasi agresif (iklan pop-up, paywall pada fitur inti)
- Aplikasi mobile native

## 4. Target Pengguna

### Persona 1 — Rani, mahasiswa Informatika semester 3
- Butuh membuat flowchart & ERD untuk laporan, merapikan PDF tugas, dan menggabungkan file.
- Pakai HP dan laptop kampus; kuota terbatas.
- Frustrasi dengan situs yang minta login dan membatasi 2 file per hari.

### Persona 2 — Dimas, developer pemula / freelancer
- Butuh format JSON, membuat README, `.gitignore`, mencoba regex, kirim file ke klien lewat link.
- Menghargai alat yang cepat dan tanpa gangguan.

### Persona 3 — Sinta, mahasiswa semester akhir (non-teknis bagian tertentu)
- Butuh pas foto berlatar merah/biru untuk berkas wisuda atau lamaran kerja.
- Ingin hasil rapi tanpa belajar software editing.

## 5. Prinsip Produk

1. **Tanpa gesekan:** buka → pakai. Tidak ada wajib login.
2. **Privasi dulu:** proses di browser; jika butuh server, jelaskan dengan jujur.
3. **Satu pola, banyak alat:** setiap alat punya tata letak dan perilaku yang konsisten.
4. **Ringan:** alat dimuat *lazy* sehingga halaman utama tetap cepat.
5. **Jujur soal batasan:** ukuran maksimum, masa berlaku link, dll. ditampilkan jelas.

## 6. Ruang Lingkup & Roadmap

### MVP (v1.0) — target 8–10 minggu
| Modul | Alat | Prioritas |
|---|---|---|
| Landing & Katalog | Beranda, pencarian alat, kategori, dark/light mode | P0 |
| **Draw** | Kanvas gambar & tulis berbasis Excalidraw | P0 |
| **Diagram** | Editor Mermaid (flowchart, ERD, sequence) + tombol buka draw.io (embed) | P0 |
| **PDF** | Merge, Split, Compress, Gambar→PDF, PDF→Gambar, Rotate | P0 |
| **Pas Foto** | Hapus/ganti background, ukuran 2×3, 3×4, 4×6 | P0 |
| **Kirim File** | Unggah → dapat link, kedaluwarsa otomatis | P0 |
| **Generator** | Markdown editor + preview + template README, JSON formatter/validator | P0 |

### v1.1 — Tambahan cepat
- `.gitignore` & LICENSE generator
- Base64 / URL encode-decode, JWT decoder
- Regex tester, Diff checker
- QR code generator
- Kompres & konversi gambar

### v2.0 — Lanjutan
- Code-to-image
- Mock data generator (JSON/CSV)
- Cron expression builder
- Color palette & contrast checker
- Akun opsional (simpan riwayat & favorit)
- PWA offline untuk alat client-side
- Berbagi sesi Draw/Diagram via link (kolaborasi ringan)

## 7. Kebutuhan Fungsional

> Format ID: **FR-[modul]-[nomor]**. Prioritas: P0 (wajib MVP), P1, P2.

### 7.1 Landing & Katalog

| ID | Kebutuhan | Prioritas |
|---|---|---|
| FR-HOME-01 | Beranda menampilkan grid kartu alat berdasarkan kategori (Gambar, Diagram, Dokumen, Foto, Berbagi, Generator). | P0 |
| FR-HOME-02 | Pencarian alat instan (nama + sinonim), dapat dibuka dengan pintasan `/` atau `Ctrl+K`. | P0 |
| FR-HOME-03 | Mode terang/gelap, mengikuti preferensi sistem dan dapat diubah manual. | P0 |
| FR-HOME-04 | Alat terakhir dipakai & favorit disimpan di `localStorage` (tanpa akun). | P1 |
| FR-HOME-05 | Pilihan bahasa Indonesia (default) dan Inggris. | P2 |

**Acceptance criteria:** pengguna dapat menemukan dan membuka alat apa pun dalam ≤ 2 klik atau 1 pencarian.

### 7.2 Draw (Excalidraw)

| ID | Kebutuhan | Prioritas |
|---|---|---|
| FR-DRAW-01 | Menyediakan kanvas gambar & tulis dengan bentuk, panah, teks, pensil bebas, dan penghapus. | P0 |
| FR-DRAW-02 | Auto-save ke `localStorage`; pulihkan saat halaman dibuka ulang. | P0 |
| FR-DRAW-03 | Ekspor PNG, SVG, dan file `.excalidraw`; impor `.excalidraw`. | P0 |
| FR-DRAW-04 | Salin ke clipboard sebagai gambar. | P1 |
| FR-DRAW-05 | Tema gelap sinkron dengan tema situs. | P1 |
| FR-DRAW-06 | Berbagi kanvas via link (hanya-baca). | P2 |

**Catatan implementasi:** gunakan paket `@excalidraw/excalidraw` (lisensi MIT) yang di-*embed* sebagai komponen React. Muat secara *lazy* agar bundle awal tetap kecil.

### 7.3 Diagram (Mermaid + draw.io)

| ID | Kebutuhan | Prioritas |
|---|---|---|
| FR-DIA-01 | Editor teks Mermaid dengan pratinjau langsung (split view; tab di HP). | P0 |
| FR-DIA-02 | Template siap pakai: flowchart, sequence, ERD, class diagram, gantt, state diagram. | P0 |
| FR-DIA-03 | Ekspor PNG, SVG, dan salin kode Mermaid. | P0 |
| FR-DIA-04 | Penanda error sintaks dengan nomor baris. | P0 |
| FR-DIA-05 | Tombol **"Editor Visual (draw.io)"** membuka embed diagrams.net untuk pengguna yang lebih suka drag-and-drop. | P1 |
| FR-DIA-06 | Simpan draf otomatis di `localStorage`. | P1 |

**Catatan implementasi:** Mermaid berlisensi MIT. diagrams.net/draw.io berlisensi Apache 2.0 dan menyediakan mode embed; integrasi dilakukan lewat iframe sesuai dokumentasi resmi mereka. Tidak menyalin merek/logo draw.io ke dalam UI Toolsman.

### 7.4 PDF Tools (setara fitur dasar iLovePDF)

| ID | Kebutuhan | Prioritas |
|---|---|---|
| FR-PDF-01 | **Gabung PDF:** unggah banyak file, urutkan dengan drag-and-drop, hasilkan satu PDF. | P0 |
| FR-PDF-02 | **Pisah PDF:** pilih rentang halaman atau ekstrak halaman tertentu. | P0 |
| FR-PDF-03 | **Kompres PDF:** tiga tingkat (Ringan / Sedang / Maksimal) dengan tampilan ukuran sebelum–sesudah. | P0 |
| FR-PDF-04 | **Gambar → PDF:** JPG/PNG ke PDF, atur orientasi dan margin. | P0 |
| FR-PDF-05 | **PDF → Gambar:** ekspor tiap halaman ke PNG/JPG. | P1 |
| FR-PDF-06 | **Putar & hapus halaman.** | P1 |
| FR-PDF-07 | **Tambah nomor halaman / watermark teks.** | P2 |
| FR-PDF-08 | Seluruh proses berjalan **di browser**; tidak ada unggahan ke server. | P0 |

**Acceptance criteria:** menggabungkan 5 PDF berukuran total 20 MB selesai < 10 detik di laptop standar dan file tidak dikirim ke jaringan (dapat diverifikasi lewat tab Network).

**Catatan implementasi:** `pdf-lib` (merge/split/rotate), `pdf.js` (render halaman), Web Worker agar UI tidak membeku. Kompres PDF di sisi klien bersifat *best-effort* (render ulang halaman gambar dengan kualitas lebih rendah); tampilkan peringatan bila hasil tidak lebih kecil.

### 7.5 Pas Foto (Ganti Background)

| ID | Kebutuhan | Prioritas |
|---|---|---|
| FR-FOTO-01 | Unggah foto (JPG/PNG/WEBP, maks. 10 MB) atau ambil dari kamera. | P0 |
| FR-FOTO-02 | Hapus background otomatis **di browser** (model ONNX/WASM, mis. `@imgly/background-removal`). | P0 |
| FR-FOTO-03 | Pilih warna latar: **merah, biru, putih, kustom** (color picker). | P0 |
| FR-FOTO-04 | Pilih ukuran cetak: **2×3, 3×4, 4×6 cm**, resolusi 300 DPI. | P0 |
| FR-FOTO-05 | Crop & posisi wajah dengan *guide* (garis kepala/bahu) dan zoom. | P0 |
| FR-FOTO-06 | Penghalusan tepi (*feather*) dan penyesuaian kecerahan dasar. | P1 |
| FR-FOTO-07 | **Lembar cetak:** susun beberapa foto pada kertas 4R/A4 siap cetak. | P1 |
| FR-FOTO-08 | Ekspor PNG/JPG; foto tidak diunggah ke server. | P0 |

**Acceptance criteria:** pengguna dapat mengubah satu foto menjadi pas foto 3×4 berlatar merah dalam ≤ 5 langkah dan ≤ 30 detik (setelah model termuat).

**Risiko & catatan:** unduhan model awal cukup besar (puluhan MB) — tampilkan indikator progres dan *cache* lewat Service Worker. Beri catatan bahwa instansi tertentu memiliki aturan pas foto sendiri (pakaian, rasio wajah).

### 7.6 Kirim File via Link

| ID | Kebutuhan | Prioritas |
|---|---|---|
| FR-SHARE-01 | Unggah satu atau beberapa file (drag-and-drop), maks. **100 MB per berkas** (dapat disesuaikan). | P0 |
| FR-SHARE-02 | Hasilkan link unik yang sulit ditebak (ID acak ≥ 128 bit) beserta tombol salin & QR code. | P0 |
| FR-SHARE-03 | Pilih masa berlaku: **1 jam / 24 jam / 7 hari**; file dihapus otomatis setelah kedaluwarsa. | P0 |
| FR-SHARE-04 | Opsi **batas unduhan** (mis. 1× unduh lalu hangus). | P1 |
| FR-SHARE-05 | Opsi **kata sandi** untuk link. | P1 |
| FR-SHARE-06 | Halaman unduhan menampilkan nama file, ukuran, dan sisa waktu. | P0 |
| FR-SHARE-07 | Progres unggah, pembatalan, dan percobaan ulang otomatis (unggah *multipart*/resumable). | P1 |
| FR-SHARE-08 | Tombol **Laporkan penyalahgunaan** pada halaman unduhan. | P0 |

**Arsitektur:** unggah langsung dari browser ke *object storage* melalui *presigned URL* (mis. Cloudflare R2 atau Supabase Storage); metadata & masa berlaku di database kecil; *cron/scheduled job* membersihkan file kedaluwarsa.

**Pengamanan & penyalahgunaan:**
- Rate limiting per IP dan Turnstile/hCaptcha ringan.
- Blokir tipe file berbahaya (`.exe`, `.bat`, `.scr`, dll.) atau beri peringatan.
- Pemindaian malware opsional (v1.1+) dan mekanisme takedown dari laporan.
- Syarat penggunaan jelas: dilarang untuk konten ilegal/melanggar hak cipta.
- Tidak mencatat isi file; log minimal dan dihapus berkala.

> **Penting:** dari semua fitur, ini yang paling berisiko disalahgunakan dan menimbulkan biaya. Mulai dengan kuota kecil dan pantau.

### 7.7 Generator (.md, JSON, dan lainnya)

| ID | Kebutuhan | Prioritas |
|---|---|---|
| FR-GEN-01 | **Markdown editor** split view dengan pratinjau GFM (tabel, task list, code block + syntax highlight). | P0 |
| FR-GEN-02 | **README generator:** form (nama proyek, deskripsi, fitur, instalasi, lisensi, badge) → keluaran `.md`. | P0 |
| FR-GEN-03 | Unduh `.md` dan salin ke clipboard. | P0 |
| FR-GEN-04 | **JSON formatter/validator:** *pretty print*, *minify*, tampilkan error + posisi baris. | P0 |
| FR-GEN-05 | **JSON ↔ CSV / YAML** konversi sederhana. | P1 |
| FR-GEN-06 | **`.gitignore` generator** (pilih bahasa/framework) dan **LICENSE generator** (MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0, dll.). | P1 |
| FR-GEN-07 | Utilitas kecil: Base64, URL encode/decode, JWT decoder, UUID, timestamp converter. | P1 |
| FR-GEN-08 | Pembuat QR code (teks/URL, unduh PNG/SVG). | P1 |

## 8. Kebutuhan Non-Fungsional

| Area | Target |
|---|---|
| **Performa** | LCP < 2,5 s di 4G; JS awal halaman beranda < 150 KB (gzip); alat berat dimuat *lazy*. |
| **Responsif** | Nyaman mulai 360 px (HP) hingga layar lebar; alat tetap fungsional di HP (tata letak menyesuaikan). |
| **Aksesibilitas** | Sesuai WCAG 2.1 AA: kontras warna, navigasi keyboard, label ARIA, *focus ring* jelas. |
| **Privasi** | Alat client-side tidak mengirim isi file ke server; kebijakan privasi singkat dan mudah dipahami. |
| **Keamanan** | HTTPS, CSP ketat, sanitasi pratinjau Markdown (cegah XSS), validasi tipe & ukuran file di server. |
| **Ketersediaan** | Target 99,5% (mengandalkan CDN/edge hosting). |
| **Kompatibilitas** | Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari (2 versi terakhir), Android Chrome, iOS Safari. |
| **Offline** | v2: PWA agar alat client-side bisa dipakai tanpa internet. |
| **Analitik** | Privacy-friendly (mis. Plausible/Umami), tanpa cookie pelacak. |
| **SEO** | Satu halaman per alat dengan judul, deskripsi, dan *structured data*; target kata kunci Indonesia ("gabung pdf online", "ganti background pas foto"). |

## 9. Arsitektur & Teknologi (Rekomendasi)

| Lapisan | Pilihan | Alasan |
|---|---|---|
| Framework | **Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript** | SSR/SSG untuk SEO, ekosistem besar, mudah dipelajari mahasiswa |
| Styling | **Tailwind CSS** + komponen bergaya shadcn/ui | Cepat, konsisten, mudah memakai design token |
| Draw | `@excalidraw/excalidraw` | Alat siap pakai (MIT) |
| Diagram | `mermaid` + embed diagrams.net | Teks→diagram + opsi visual |
| PDF | `pdf-lib`, `pdfjs-dist`, Web Worker | Proses lokal |
| Hapus background | `@imgly/background-removal` (ONNX/WASM) | Berjalan di browser |
| Markdown | `react-markdown` / `marked` + `DOMPurify` + `highlight.js` | Pratinjau aman |
| Editor kode | CodeMirror 6 | Ringan dan modular |
| Kirim file | Cloudflare R2 (atau Supabase Storage) + Workers/Edge Functions + D1/Postgres | Egress murah, presigned upload |
| Hosting | Vercel atau Cloudflare Pages | Tier gratis memadai untuk MVP |
| Analitik | Plausible / Umami | Privasi |

**Struktur modul alat (konvensi):**
```
/app
  /tools/[slug]/page.tsx     ← halaman alat (SEO)
/features
  /draw  /diagram  /pdf  /photo  /share  /generator
    ├─ components/
    ├─ lib/ (logika murni, mudah diuji)
    └─ meta.ts (nama, slug, ikon, kategori, sinonim pencarian)
```
Katalog beranda dibangun otomatis dari `meta.ts` setiap alat, sehingga menambah alat baru tidak mengubah kode beranda.

## 10. Alur Pengguna Utama

**Ganti background pas foto**
1. Beranda → *Pas Foto* → unggah foto
2. Model memuat (progres) → background terhapus otomatis
3. Pilih warna (merah/biru) & ukuran (3×4)
4. Atur posisi wajah dengan panduan
5. Unduh PNG / lembar cetak

**Kirim file**
1. *Kirim File* → seret berkas
2. Pilih masa berlaku (+ opsi sandi)
3. Unggah → link + QR muncul
4. Salin & bagikan → penerima membuka halaman unduhan

## 11. Metrik Keberhasilan

| Metrik | Target 3 bulan pertama |
|---|---|
| Pengguna aktif bulanan | 2.000+ (organik dari kampus & komunitas) |
| Tingkat penyelesaian tugas alat (hasil diunduh/disalin) | ≥ 60% |
| Alat dipakai per sesi | ≥ 1,5 |
| LCP rata-rata | < 2,5 s |
| Laporan penyalahgunaan yang tertangani < 24 jam | 100% |
| Skor kepuasan (survei 1 pertanyaan) | ≥ 4/5 |

## 12. Risiko & Mitigasi

| Risiko | Dampak | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| Penyalahgunaan layanan kirim file | Hukum, biaya | Batas ukuran/kedaluwarsa, rate limit, laporan, ToS, mulai dengan kuota kecil |
| Biaya storage/bandwidth membengkak | Operasional | R2 (tanpa biaya egress), batas harian, hapus otomatis |
| Model hapus background berat di HP lama | UX buruk | Indikator progres, cache model, opsi resolusi lebih rendah |
| Kompres PDF di klien kurang optimal | Ekspektasi tidak terpenuhi | Jujur soal batasan; pertimbangkan *server fallback* opsional di v1.1 |
| Lisensi pustaka pihak ketiga | Hukum | Audit lisensi; patuhi atribusi (Excalidraw MIT, Mermaid MIT, draw.io Apache-2.0) |
| Menyerupai produk lain (merek dagang) | Hukum | Nama, logo, dan UI orisinal; tidak memakai nama/merek iLovePDF, Excalidraw, draw.io sebagai merek Toolsman |
| Scope terlalu luas untuk tim kecil | Jadwal molor | Disiplin MVP; satu alat selesai dulu sebelum lanjut |

## 13. Rencana Rilis (Sprint 2 Minggu)

| Sprint | Fokus |
|---|---|
| S1 | Setup proyek, design system, layout, beranda + pencarian, dark mode |
| S2 | Generator: Markdown editor, README, JSON formatter |
| S3 | PDF: merge, split, image→PDF |
| S4 | Draw (Excalidraw) + Diagram (Mermaid) |
| S5 | Pas Foto + (opsional) kompres PDF |
| S6 | Kirim File + pengamanan, uji beban kecil |
| S7 | QA, aksesibilitas, SEO, beta bersama teman kampus |

## 14. Pertanyaan Terbuka

1. Apakah batas 100 MB per file untuk Kirim File sudah sesuai dengan anggaran hosting?
2. Apakah perlu akun opsional (login Google/GitHub) sejak v1, atau tunggu v2?
3. Apakah Toolsman akan open-source di GitHub (berpotensi menarik kontributor dari kampus)?
4. Domain yang diinginkan (mis. `toolsman.id`, `toolsman.app`)?
5. Apakah ada kebutuhan kolaborasi real-time pada Draw di tahap awal?

## 15. Lampiran — Ringkasan Prioritas

- **Harus ada (P0):** Katalog + pencarian, Draw, Mermaid, PDF merge/split/kompres/gambar→PDF, Pas Foto, Kirim File, Markdown/README, JSON formatter
- **Segera menyusul (P1):** draw.io embed, PDF→gambar, `.gitignore`/LICENSE, Base64/JWT/Regex/Diff, QR code, password & one-time link
- **Nanti (P2):** akun, PWA, kolaborasi, code-to-image, mock data, cron builder

252: ### 6.1 Tombol

254: | Varian | Gaya | Pemakaian |

262: Target sentuh minimal **44×44 px**.

280: │                               │

282: └───────────────────────────────┘

284: - Latar `--surface`, border `--border`, radius `lg`, padding 20 px.

294: **Palet perintah (Ctrl+K):** modal `--radius-xl`, daftar alat dengan ikon, navigasi panah + Enter.

301: ### 6.6 Umpan Balik

303: | Komponen | Perilaku |
304: |---|---|
305: | **Toast** | Kanan-bawah (desktop) / bawah penuh (mobile), hilang 4 dtk; berisi aksi *Batalkan* bila relevan |
306: | **Progress bar** | 6 px, radius penuh, `--accent`; tampilkan persen + estimasi untuk unggahan/proses > 2 dtk |
307: | **Skeleton** | Untuk memuat alat berat (Excalidraw, model foto) |
308: | **Alert inline** | Latar semantik 10% + ikon + teks; dipakai untuk peringatan batasan |
309: | **Dialog konfirmasi** | Hanya untuk tindakan destruktif/tak dapat dibatalkan |
310: 
311: ### 6.7 Modal & Panel
312: 
313: Modal maksimum 480 px (konfirmasi) / 720 px (pengaturan), overlay `rgba(0,0,0,.5)`, tutup dengan `Esc` dan klik overlay, fokus dikunci di dalam modal, fokus kembali ke pemicu setelah ditutup.
314: 
315: ## 7. Tata Letak Halaman
316: 
317: ### 7.1 Beranda
318: 
319: ```
320: ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
321: │ Header: Logo  [ Cari alat…  Ctrl+K ]      ☀/🌙   Tentang │
322: ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
323: │ HERO                                                     │
324: │  "Semua perkakas kuliahmu, satu kotak."                  │
325: │  Gratis · Tanpa login · File diproses di perangkatmu     │
326: │  [ Cari alat… ]                                          │
327: │  Chip: Semua  Gambar  Diagram  Dokumen  Foto  Berbagi  Generator │
328: ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
329: │ Grid kartu alat (4 kol desktop · 2 tablet · 1 mobile)    │
330: │ ┌────┐ ┌────┐ ┌────┐ ┌────┐                              │
331: │ └────┘ └────┘ └────┘ └────┘                              │
332: ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
333: │ "Terakhir dipakai" & "Favorit" (jika ada)                │
334: ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
335: │ Mengapa Toolsman? 3 poin: Gratis · Privat · Cepat        │
336: ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
337: │ Footer: Privasi · Syarat · GitHub · Laporkan masalah     │
338: └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
339: ```
340: 
341: ### 7.2 Halaman Alat (pola umum)
342: 
343: ```
344: ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
345: │ Header global                                            │
346: ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
347: │ Breadcrumb                                               │
348: │ [ikon] Judul Alat (H1)           [badge privasi]         │
349: │ Deskripsi satu kalimat                                   │
350: ├───────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────┤
351: │                               │ PANEL OPSI               │
352: │   AREA KERJA                  │ - Pengaturan             │
353: │   (dropzone / kanvas /        │ - Pilihan                │
354: │    editor / pratinjau)        │                          │
355: │                               │ [ AKSI UTAMA ]           │
356: ├───────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────┤
357: │ Cara pakai (3 langkah) · FAQ singkat · Alat terkait      │
358: └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
359: ```
360: Mobile: panel opsi pindah **di bawah** area kerja; tombol aksi utama menempel di bawah layar (*sticky bottom bar*).
361: 
362: ## 8. Spesifikasi Per Alat
363: 
364: ### 8.1 Draw (Excalidraw)
365: - Kanvas mengisi tinggi layar (`100dvh – header`), tanpa padding agar luas.
366: - Tema kanvas mengikuti tema situs.
367: - Bar kecil di atas kanvas: nama berkas (dapat diedit), status *"Tersimpan otomatis"*, tombol Ekspor.
368: - Header/footer situs dapat diciutkan (mode fokus, tombol `F`).
369: 
370: ### 8.2 Diagram (Mermaid)
371: - Desktop: **split view** — editor kode (kiri, mono) | pratinjau (kanan), pembatas dapat digeser.
372: - Mobile: tab **Kode / Pratinjau**.
373: - Dropdown **Template** di atas editor; error sintaks tampil sebagai garis merah bergelombang + pesan di bawah editor.
374: - Tombol "Editor Visual (draw.io)" bergaya sekunder dengan ikon tautan-luar; jelaskan dalam tooltip bahwa ini membuka editor diagrams.net.
375: 
376: ### 8.3 PDF Tools
377: - Halaman pemilih (grid kartu: Gabung, Pisah, Kompres, Gambar→PDF, PDF→Gambar, Putar).
378: - Alur 3 langkah dengan *stepper* ringkas: **Pilih file → Atur → Unduh**.
379: - Daftar file berupa kartu dengan *thumbnail* halaman pertama, nama, ukuran (mono), pegangan *drag* ⋮⋮, dan tombol hapus.
380: - Kompres: *segmented control* tiga tingkat + perbandingan ukuran "2,4 MB → 0,9 MB (−62%)".
381: 
382: ### 8.4 Pas Foto
383: - Langkah: **1 Unggah → 2 Latar → 3 Ukuran & Posisi → 4 Unduh**.
384: - Pratinjau dengan **guide overlay** (oval kepala, garis bahu) yang bisa disembunyikan.
385: - Pemilih warna: *swatch* bulat besar — Merah `#DB1F26`, Biru `#0F5BD8`, Putih `#FFFFFF`, + kustom. (Nilai bawaan dapat disesuaikan dengan standar instansi.)
386: - *Segmented control* ukuran: `2×3` `3×4` `4×6`.
387: - Saat model dimuat: skeleton + progres "Menyiapkan penghapus latar (sekali saja)…".
388: - Catatan kecil: "Aturan pas foto tiap instansi bisa berbeda. Cek persyaratanmu."
389: 
390: ### 8.5 Kirim File
391: - Dropzone besar di tengah; setelah unggah, daftar berkas + progres per file.
392: - Panel opsi: **Berlaku** (`1 jam` `24 jam` `7 hari`), **Sandi** (toggle), **Sekali unduh** (toggle).
393: - Hasil: kartu sukses dengan link (mono, tombol *Salin*), QR code, sisa waktu hitung mundur.
394: - Halaman unduhan penerima: nama file, ukuran, kedaluwarsa, tombol **Unduh** besar, tautan "Laporkan".
395: - Tampilkan batasan di bawah dropzone: *"Maks. 100 MB per berkas · dihapus otomatis"*.
396: 
397: ### 8.6 Generator
398: - **Markdown:** split editor | pratinjau; toolbar (B, I, H, daftar, kode, tautan, tabel); tombol *Salin* dan *Unduh .md*.
399: - **README generator:** form bertahap di kiri, pratinjau langsung di kanan.
400: - **JSON:** dua panel (Input | Hasil), tombol `Format`, `Minify`, `Salin`; error menunjukkan baris & kolom; hasil bergaya *syntax-highlight* dengan lipatan (collapse) node.
401: 
402: ## 9. Konten & Gaya Bahasa (UX Writing)
403: 
404: | Prinsip | Contoh |
405: |---|---|
406: | Santai, jelas, pakai "kamu" | "Seret file PDF kamu ke sini" |
407: | Kata kerja di tombol | "Gabungkan", "Unduh", "Salin link" |
408: | Error membantu | "File lebih dari 100 MB. Kompres dulu atau pecah jadi beberapa bagian." |
409: | Jujur soal privasi | "Diproses di perangkatmu — file tidak diunggah." |
410: | Hindari jargon & lelucon berlebihan | Tidak memakai emoji di UI fungsional |
411: 
412: **Judul halaman (hero):** *"Semua perkakas kuliahmu, satu kotak."*
413: **Placeholder pencarian:** *"Cari alat… (mis. gabung pdf, flowchart)"*
414: 
415: ## 10. Aksesibilitas (WCAG 2.1 AA)
416: 
417: - Kontras teks ≥ 4,5:1 (teks besar ≥ 3:1) di kedua tema; periksa pasangan `--text-muted` pada `--surface-2`.
418: - Semua fungsi dapat dioperasikan dengan keyboard; urutan fokus logis; `:focus-visible` memakai `--ring`.
419: - Dropzone selalu menyediakan tombol **"Pilih file"** (bukan hanya drag-and-drop).
420: - Label ARIA untuk ikon-saja; `aria-live="polite"` untuk toast dan progres.
421: - Jangan mengandalkan warna saja (error juga memakai ikon + teks; kategori juga memakai label).
422: - Dukungan `prefers-reduced-motion` dan `prefers-color-scheme`.
423: - Target sentuh ≥ 44 px; ukuran teks dapat diperbesar hingga 200% tanpa kehilangan fungsi.
424: 
425: ## 11. Responsif
426: 
427: | Layar | Perilaku |
428: |---|---|
429: | **< 768 px** | Satu kolom; panel opsi di bawah area kerja; *sticky action bar*; editor split → tab |
430: | **768–1023 px** | Grid 2 kolom di beranda; area kerja penuh, panel opsi bisa dilipat |
431: | **≥ 1024 px** | Area kerja + panel opsi berdampingan (panel 320–360 px) |
432: | **≥ 1280 px** | Grid 4 kolom di beranda; kanvas/editor memanfaatkan lebar maksimum |
433: 
434: ## 12. Dark Mode
435: 
436: - Default mengikuti sistem; toggle manual tersimpan di `localStorage`.
437: - Gunakan token, **bukan** warna hardcode, agar semua komponen berubah otomatis.
438: - Gambar hasil (pas foto, ekspor diagram) tidak ikut dibalik warnanya; latar pratinjau dibuat netral/kotak-kotak (*checkerboard*) agar transparansi terlihat.
439: 
440: ## 13. Performa Desain
441: 
442: - Font: *subset* Latin, `font-display: swap`, maksimal 2 keluarga dimuat di awal (Plus Jakarta Sans + Inter); JetBrains Mono dimuat hanya saat dibutuhkan.
443: - Ikon dimuat per-ikon (tree-shaking), bukan seluruh pustaka.
444: - Alat berat (Excalidraw, model foto, PDF engine) dimuat *lazy* setelah pengguna membuka halaman alat; tampilkan skeleton.
445: - Hindari gambar dekoratif besar; gunakan CSS/SVG.
446: 
447: ## 14. Do & Don't
448: 
449: | ✅ Lakukan | ❌ Hindari |
450: |---|---|
451: | Satu tombol primer per layar | Banyak tombol berwarna aksen bersaing |
452: | Teks bantuan spesifik dan ramah | Pesan "Terjadi kesalahan" tanpa solusi |
453: | Tampilkan batasan di awal | Menyembunyikan batas ukuran sampai gagal |
454: | Warna aksen hemat (tombol, status aktif) | Latar penuh warna aksen di banyak area |
455: | Konsisten dengan token | Warna/ukuran acak per halaman |
456: | Badge privasi yang jujur | Klaim "100% aman" tanpa penjelasan |
457: 
458: ## 15. Daftar Periksa Implementasi
459: 
460: - [ ] Token CSS & konfigurasi Tailwind terpasang; mode terang/gelap berfungsi
461: - [ ] Font dimuat dengan strategi performa
462: - [ ] Komponen dasar: Button, Input, Dropzone, Card, Tabs, Toast, Modal, Progress, Chip
463: - [ ] Layout beranda + palet perintah `Ctrl+K`
464: - [ ] Template halaman alat (header alat, area kerja, panel opsi, FAQ)
465: - [ ] Audit kontras & navigasi keyboard
466: - [ ] Uji di 360 px, 768 px, 1280 px
467: - [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` dihormati
468: 
469: ## 16. Aset yang Perlu Dibuat
470: 
471: 1. Logo wordmark + ikon (SVG, versi terang/gelap)
472: 2. Favicon & ikon PWA (192, 512 px)
473: 3. Gambar OG/Twitter per kategori (1200×630)
474: 4. Set ikon alat (Lucide + kustomisasi bila perlu)
475: 5. Ilustrasi empty state (garis sederhana)
476: 
477: ---
478: 
479: *Dokumen hidup: perbarui bersama perubahan produk. Setiap komponen baru harus memakai token di Bagian 3.*

(End of file - total 479 lines)
